description:
The Hyper 16in Balance E-bike for kids is purpose-built for young riders ready to level up. Engineered for performance, progression, and control, this electric balance bike packs a punch with a high-torque 400W brushless motor, 3 selectable speed modes, and a removable 18V 6.0Ah battery. Whether your rider is just learning or already chasing dirt and jumps, the Hyper 16in delivers real throttle response, real stopping power, and real trail-ready handling.

With a sturdy alloy frame, performance mag wheels, and a rear drum brake, this bike is designed to take abuse and keep charging—mile after mile. From backyard sessions to pump track progressions, it’s the ultimate tool to build skill, confidence, and throttle control. This isn’t a toy. It’s a gateway to real riding.
